item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
Fixed

  • More reliable Apple Ads reconnects. Campaigns, ad groups, keywords, and ads now stay correctly matched to the selected Apple Ads account after reconnecting or switching campaign groups.
  • Ad groups no longer disappear from the dashboard. Fixed cases where ad groups could exist locally but not show in the sidebar or main tables after syncing.
  • Keyword loading is more dependable. ADSwift now refreshes keywords when older cached rows do not belong to the currently selected campaign group.

Improved

  • Smoother app-to-All Campaigns navigation. Switching from a specific app back to All Campaigns feels more responsive, without changing the underlying data fetching.
  • Loading shimmer stays in place. Revenue and profit loading states keep the animated shimmer while heavier chart rendering waits for the first transition paint.
  • Table column preferences are more stable. Column visibility choices now persist more consistently across navigation and app relaunches.
